question: Should this PR intentionally fail closed for pre-fix non-admin bearer bridge grants during upgrade to close the shared-token revocation gap?
rationale: The security fix is narrow, but the upgrade behavior can disconnect existing shared-token bridge sessions; automation should not decide that operator-impact tradeoff alone.

options.title: Accept fail-closed upgrade behavior
options.body: Proceed with the security boundary fix, require real behavior proof, and document the legacy-session disconnect behavior in release-owned notes.

options.title: Require compatibility preservation
options.body: Ask for a compatibility path that preserves already-open legacy shared-token bridges until explicit token rotation, accepting a narrower immediate security fix.

options.title: Pause for security design review
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide the permanent bridge-grant credential contract and upgrade policy.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed upgrade behavior
recommendation.body: Proceed with the security boundary fix, require real behavior proof, and document the legacy-session disconnect behavior in release-owned notes.
